name: Spectral Blur
description: Smears and freezes the spectrum: every frequency hangs for as long as Blur says, phases dissolve into a diffuse wash, and Freeze holds the moment as a slowly living drone.

params.name: Blur
params.description: How long each frequency hangs after the sound has moved on. Low is a short haze; high sustains it for many seconds.

params.name: Smear
params.description: Scrambles the phase of every frequency, which dissolves attacks into a diffuse wash. At zero the phases are left as they are.

params.name: Freeze
params.description: On holds the spectrum of the moment and ignores new input. The held sound keeps drifting a little, so it is a slow drone and not a loop.

params.name: Tilt
params.description: Leans the tone of the wet signal. Negative values are darker and bassier, positive values brighter and thinner.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Removes lows from the wet signal. At its lowest setting it is off.

params.name: High Cut
params.description: Removes highs from the wet signal. At its highest setting it is off.

params.name: Shimmer
params.description: Adds a copy of the blurred sound an octave higher. Low is a faint halo; high is a bright octave over everything.

params.name: Width
params.description: Makes the smearing differ between left and right, which widens the wash. At zero a mono input stays mono. Needs Smear or Freeze to act.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the blurred one.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on kit::Fft. A real-time relative of Paul's Extreme Sound Stretch (held magnitudes, random phase per frame) with a phase-vocoder path for the unsmeared sound; not a port of either.
